scope.source: width-1..3 CNF exactly partitioned by the frozen typed mosaic into 2CNF/HORN3/DUAL_HORN3 modules
scope.interaction: connected simple module graph with cycle rank at least two
scope.canonical_tree: lexicographically rooted/sorted BFS spanning tree only
scope.feedback_interface: B = union of exact separators on E\T
scope.conditioned_tree_boundary: after removing B, each module tree-boundary <= floor(log2(max(2,L)))

theorem: For every instance in the frozen scope, deterministic canonical BFS feedback discovery plus exhaustive exact conditioning on the canonical feedback interface B and exact conditioned typed-module tree DP decides SAT exactly with polynomial total construction, discovery, solve, reconstruction and verification cost.

finite_falsifier_record.scientific_role: implementation/counterexample attack only; not theorem evidence
finite_falsifier_record.primary_gate: cycle-rank-2 K_2_3 SAT and UNSAT controls

proof_carrying_caveat: UNSAT semantic verification is polynomially replayable by deterministic recomputation, but this successor does not define a new compact serialized rejection-proof language for every feedback assignment.
canonical_tree_caveat: The theorem uses one deterministic BFS spanning tree. It does not search for or claim existence/nonexistence of a lower-width alternative spanning tree.
